attributes.description: Man Industries Ltd. is one of the largest Manufacturers and Exporters of LSAW and HSAW pipes in India with a total installed capacity of 1 million tonnes. The company is among leading manufacturer of large diameter pipes with 3 Decades of presence in Pipe Industry.
